mapper.select: SELECT CAST(leave_type_id AS CHAR) AS leaveTypeId, type_name AS typeName, type_code AS typeCode, unit_mode AS unitMode, balance_required AS balanceRequired FROM oa_attendance_leave_type WHERE status='ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_no,leave_type_id

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(le.legal_entity_id AS CHAR) AS legalEntityId, le.legal_entity_name AS legalEntityName, le.legal_entity_code AS legalEntityCode FROM sys_dept d JOIN sys_dept owner ON owner.dept_id=d.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(owner.dept_id,d.ancestors) JOIN sys_legal_entity le ON le.legal_entity_id=owner.legal_entity_id WHERE d.dept_id=#{ownerDeptId} AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' AND owner.status='0' AND owner.del_flag='0' AND le.status='0' ORDER BY legalEntityName,legalEntityId
mapper.sql:
FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_profile p ON p.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id=u.dept_id AND dept.status='0' AND dept.del_flag='0' JOIN sys_dept root ON root.dept_id=#{ownerDeptId} AND root.status='0' AND root.del_flag='0' WHERE u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND p.employee_status IN ('试用','正式','在职','待离职') AND (dept.dept_id=root.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(root.dept_id,dept.ancestors))
AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(u.nick_name,''))>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(u.user_name,''))>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(p.employee_no,''))>0)

FROM oa_attendance_day_result r JOIN oa_attendance_schedule s ON s.schedule_id=r.schedule_id AND s.status='PUBLISHED' AND s.user_id=r.user_id AND s.shop_id=r.shop_id AND s.business_date=r.business_date JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=r.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' JOIN sys_user_profile p ON p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.employee_status IN ('试用','正式','在职','待离职') JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id=u.dept_id AND dept.status='0' AND dept.del_flag='0' JOIN sys_dept root ON root.dept_id=#{ownerDeptId} AND root.status='0' AND root.del_flag='0' WHERE r.shop_id=#{ownerDeptId} AND (dept.dept_id=root.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(root.dept_id,dept.ancestors)) AND r.business_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND r.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND r.row_version IS NOT NULL AND r.row_version>=0 AND r.scheduled_minutes>=0 AND r.worked_minutes>r.scheduled_minutes
AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(u.nick_name,''))>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(u.user_name,''))>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(p.employee_no,''))>0)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(r.day_result_id AS CHAR) AS dayResultId, CAST(r.row_version AS CHAR) AS rowVersion, CAST(r.user_id AS CHAR) AS userId, CAST(r.shop_id AS CHAR) AS shopId, CAST(r.schedule_id AS CHAR) AS scheduleId, r.user_name AS userName,r.business_date AS businessDate,r.worked_minutes AS workedMinutes, r.scheduled_minutes AS scheduledMinutes,r.settled_at AS settledAt,r.result_status AS resultStatus ORDER BY r.business_date DESC,r.day_result_id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
